english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong word for a lorry or goods truck.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a lorry or truck used to carry goods.

examples.english: That goods truck already delivered the goods to the warehouse this morning.
examples.traditional: 嗰架貨車朝早已經送咗啲貨去倉庫。
